verdict.rationale: Databricks documents an ingestion connector picker (docs-20) plus Lakeflow/Auto Loader ETL pipelines (docs-1,13,40) and a dedicated partner page for dbt (docs-10,14,35), showing first-party and partner-tool coverage for ingestion. However, the pack lacks concrete evidence of a detailed catalog of named SaaS/database connectors (e.g., Salesforce, Workday, specific DB connectors) with per-connector setup docs beyond the generic ingestion landing page. missing for 10: named SaaS/database connector list with individual setup guides, evidence of partner ETL/ELT tool breadth beyond dbt, independent validation of connector reliability.
